title: VisCache: Visual KV Cache Pruning for Efficient Vision Large Language Model Inference
abstract: arXiv:2608.24063v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: While Vision Large Language Models (VLLMs) have achieved remarkable success in multimodal reasoning, their long-context inference remains prohibitively expensive due to the massive computation and memory overhead of visual Key-Value (KV) caches. Existing KV compression methods often apply uniform pruning across visual tokens and layers, leading to substantial information loss and degraded performance.To address this challenge, we propose \textbf{VisCache}, a plug-and-play framework for coarse-to-fine \textbf{Vis}ual KV \textbf{Cache} pruning without training, which consists of two synergistic stages. First, a lightweight VLM filters temporal redundancy by selectively forwarding semantically informative keyframes. translated_title: VisCache：用于高效视觉大语言模型推理的视觉KV缓存剪枝
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.24063v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：尽管视觉大语言模型（VLLMs）在多模态推理方面取得了显著成功，但其长上下文推理仍因视觉键值（KV）缓存的巨大计算和内存开销而代价高昂。现有的KV压缩方法通常对视觉标记和层进行均匀剪枝，导致大量信息损失和性能下降。为解决这一挑战，我们提出了VisCache，一个无需训练的即插即用框架，用于从粗到细的视觉KV缓存剪枝，包含两个协同阶段。首先，一个轻量级VLM通过选择性转发语义上有信息量的关键帧来过滤时间冗余。其次，我们引入了PruneKV，一种针对VLLMs注意力动态量身定制的外科式KV压缩算法。与刚性剪枝策略不同，PruneKV采用抛物线式的逐层预算分配以及不对称的剪枝策略。
tldr: 本文提出VisCache框架，通过轻量级关键帧筛选和PruneKV算法实现无需训练的视觉KV缓存剪枝，以显著降低VLLM推理开销并保持性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes VisCache, a training-free framework that combines lightweight keyframe filtering and the PruneKV algorithm for coarse-to-fine visual KV cache pruning, significantly reducing VLLM inference costs while maintaining performance.
